title: Correct #11979's goal wording to 「no NULL-organization grant row」 — the engine-lane half of #18411, which the filing card explicitly left cross-lane
body:
Filed by the `domain:services` seat (objectstack#6021), `session_01QGMBhvUoyD8t5zY8xHQhnP`, as the **second half of #18411**. ⛔ Unlabelled for `domain:*` and ungraded on purpose — routing and grading are the triage seat's, and an execution seat does not produce `domain:*`.

## Why this is a separate card

#18411 (filed at the maintainer's direction) rules that two cards state their goal in a way that is **wider than the governing record requires**, and names both: **#18336** and **#11979**. It then says in as many words that the second is ⛔ not its own to perform:

> ⇒ Apply to **#18336**'s body and **#11979**'s body. ⚠️ #11979 is `domain:engine`, so its half is a cross-lane ask, ⛔ not this filing's to perform.

⇒ The `domain:services` half is **done** (#18336's body corrected, recorded on that card). This card carries the remaining half so the ask lives in a queue rather than in a comment — a cross-seat request is work, and ⛔ a comment is never its only carrier.

## The correction

| | |
|---|---|
| ❌ today | 「config-derived standing is the only channel」 |
| ✅ ruled | 「**no grant row with a NULL `organization` remains**」 |

## Why the wording is load-bearing, ⛔ not cosmetic

Read literally, 「the only channel」 deletes the zero-config `single`-posture first-user promotion, which **ADR-0131 explicitly keeps**. ⭐ Verbatim from `docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md` § **D5**, re-read on `origin/main` by this seat (⛔ not quoted second-hand from #18411):

> The `single`-posture first-user promotion (Choice 4A), which today writes an `admin_full_access` grant row with a NULL organization, writes it **owned by the Default Organization** instead; under a walled posture no grant row is written (unchanged). `reportLegacyPlatformAdminGrant` and the legacy unscoped anchor retire with D13. **No NULL grant row is ever produced.**

⇒ ADR-0131 changes that row's **ownership**, ⛔ not its existence. The ADR's own title — 「total organization ownership, no NULL organization_id」 — is about the anchor, ⛔ not about making config the sole channel.

The maintainer's own framing of the operational case, quoted in #18411: 「比如临时启动的开发环境，我不可能去配置啊」 — a throw-away dev rig, a preview deploy, a test box. Nobody sets `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` for those, and under the default posture nobody should have to.

## Scope

- ⛔ **Wording only.** This does ⛔ not decide any fork on #11979, does ⛔ not change its scope, priority or state.
- ⛔ This card does ⛔ not claim #11979's own work is wrong — only that the sentence describing its goal asks for more than the governing record does.
- ⚠️ This seat has ⛔ **not** read #11979's body to locate the exact sentence — that is the receiving lane's to do, on its own reading. The exact spelling on #18336 was `so that config-derived standing is the only channel.`; #11979 may phrase it differently.

## Dedupe words

`config is the only channel wording` · `11979 goal wording NULL organization` · `ADR-0131 D5 Default Organization owned grant row` · `zero-config single posture promotion` · `18411 engine-lane half`
